decisions.reason: The footer-specific content and background treatment do not modify the landing page's independently defined hero and visual-system attributes.
The source concerns the public website footer, not the separate footer element within the SaaS console shell.
The website footer expansion does not alter the How It Works section's position, presentation, or steps.
The source specifies footer content and styling but establishes no new cross-page responsive rule.
A possible Frequency-brand footer background does not necessarily change the requested global token sheet or resolve its outstanding scope ambiguity.
Adding footer content does not change whether the previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The footer expansion supplies no change to the landing page's responsive-layout behavior.
The footer content and visual treatment do not change the selected plain HTML and Tailwind implementation stack.
